summary: Query route — voice snapshot at session creation, getSystemPrompt(session.voice) at query
description: IMPL §5. Two touch points in src/app/api/query/route.ts: (1) at sessions INSERT, snapshot voice = (tier==='pro' && isVoiceSlug(prefs.preferredVoice)) ? prefs.preferredVoice : 'scholar'; (2) at query execution, call getSystemPrompt(session.voice). Free users always 'scholar' regardless of stored pref. Profile voice changes do NOT mutate existing sessions (snapshot is immutable). See IMPL §5.
